policy.immutable_sources: Every image is identified by full commit SHA and path. Existing IDs and source records must not be overwritten.
policy.editing_base: Use the image/version explicitly selected by the owner as the fixed base. Change only specified parts; do not substitute the current implementation or regenerate other routes without instruction.
policy.rejected: Keep rejection status visible. Browsing an archived rejected image does not adopt it.
